page.privateLink: Private link for the recipient of this invoice. Please do not forward it.

draft.title: Draft
draft.body: This document has not been issued yet. Details and amounts may change until it is issued.

amount.paidBody: This invoice has been paid. Thank you!
amount.cancelledBody: This document was cancelled. Nothing is owed.
amount.notPayableBody: This document cannot be paid through this link. Please contact the issuer to arrange payment.

payNow.title: Pay now
payNow.cardHint: Visa, Mastercard and, where supported, Apple Pay or Google Pay. You pay on the payment provider’s secure page, in a new tab.
payNow.irisHint: Instant payment from your bank account: on the provider’s secure page you choose your bank or scan a QR code, then approve the amount in your banking app.
payNow.secureNote: Your card or account details never pass through us.
payNow.noMethodBody: No payment method is available through this link. Please contact the issuer to arrange payment.
payNow.processingBody: As soon as the provider confirms the payment, this page will show “Paid”. This usually takes a few seconds.
payNow.processingSlow: Confirmation is taking longer. If you completed the payment, do not pay again: it will appear once confirmed.
payNow.failedBody: Please try again or choose another payment method. If you do see a charge, it will appear here automatically once confirmed.
payNow.timedOutTitle: We have not received confirmation yet
payNow.timedOutBody: If you completed the payment, do not pay again: it will appear here once the provider confirms it. If you did not complete it, you can try again.

errors.method-unavailable: This payment method is not available. Please choose another method.
errors.provider-unavailable: The payment provider did not respond. Try again shortly or pay by bank transfer.
errors.not-payable: Nothing is owed on this invoice any more. Please refresh the page.
errors.generic: The payment did not start. Check your connection and try again.

pay.title: Pay by bank transfer
pay.scanHint: The SEPA QR code fills in the beneficiary, IBAN, amount and reference. Check them before you approve.
pay.noQr: No QR code is available for this account. Use the details below.
pay.referenceHint: Enter the reference exactly as shown, so your payment is matched to this invoice automatically.
pay.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the text and copy it manually.

contact.title: Contact the issuer
contact.chatViaCopy: Chat with the issuer on {channel} (the message is copied for pasting)
contact.draftCopied: Message copied. Paste it into the chat.
contact.chatDraft: Hello, I am contacting you about document {number}.

messages.title: Write to us
messages.intro: Send your question about document {number}. The issuer's reply will appear here.
messages.label: Your message
messages.remaining: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
messages.sent: Your message was sent to the issuer.

errors.invalidText: Write a message of up to {max} characters.
errors.quotaExhausted: You have sent many messages today. Try again tomorrow or use the contact details.
errors.expired: This page has been open for a long time. Refresh the page: your text will be kept.
errors.generic: The message was not sent. Your text is kept; please try again.

replyEmail.subject: Reply about document {reference}
replyEmail.intro: {issuer} replied to your message about document {reference}:
replyEmail.continue: To continue the conversation, open the document link from the email you received.

refused.title: This invoice is not available
refused.body: This link is no longer active. Please ask the issuer of the invoice for a new link.
refused.loadFailed: Loading failed. Check your connection and try again.
